subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and minimal deliverables
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <security@brightedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor security intake for BrightEdge's AI integrations, we need your SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully cover our contract window (June 1–Nov 30, 2026). Please include:

- The SOC 2 Type II report PDF (full report or redacted copy)
- The auditor's opinion and the covered period
- Any available SOC 3 or SOC 2 summary if full report is restricted
- A bridge letter template if the report ends before Nov 30, 2026

Also let me know your preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, secure Drive link, or an auditing portal) and an estimated delivery date. If you have a short reply template we like to use for procurement, that helps speed up internal routing.

Thanks —
Marta
Senior Security Manager
BrightEdge Technologies
security@brightedge.com

Attachment: intake-checklist.csv (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@brightedge.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period question

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and an auditor-signed bridge letter if needed. Quick answers up front:

- Report availability: We can share a redacted PDF covering the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (Type II) by EOD Tuesday, May 4.
- Bridge letter: Yes — we'll provide a one-page auditor-signed bridge letter covering the gap to Nov 30, 2026 (if requested) within 48 hours of your confirmation.
- Transfer options: secure Google Drive with restricted viewers + DLP, SFTP push to your intake host, or a pre-signed temporary download link from our secure transfer service. Recommend Drive link for speed or SFTP for procurement systems.

I pasted a short reply template and a minimal deliverables checklist below that you can forward internally. If you prefer, I can upload the files to the Drive link you share or initiate an SFTP push.

--- Reply template (one-line) ---
Redwood Inference has provided a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30) and an auditor-signed bridge letter covering the remainder of the requested window. Files delivered via secure Drive link. Contact: soojin.lee@redwood.ai.

--- Minimal deliverables checklist (what we'll share) ---
• Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — opinion and control testing results
• Bridge letter (auditor cover letter / statement) — if the audit period ends before requested window
• SOC 2 summary (one pager) — high level scope and exclusions
• Transfer manifest (list of files and checksums)

Let me know which transfer option you want and whether BrightEdge needs a full report or redacted version only.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments referenced: redwood_soc2_typeII_summary.pdf (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <security@brightedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period question

Hi Soojin —

Thanks, that timeline works. Quick clarifications:

1) The contract window we care about is June 1–Nov 30, 2026. If your Type II period ends 2026-06-30, the bridge letter must explicitly state controls remained in place through Nov 30, 2026 or explain compensating controls.
2) We prefer Drive link for initial review; our procurement team will request SFTP if they need direct ingestion.
3) Can you include a short statement about retention and logging (location of logs, retention duration) in the SOC 2 summary? A 2–3 sentence note is sufficient.

If you can upload the redacted report and the bridge letter to the Drive folder (with access for marta.ruiz@brightedge.com) by EOD May 4, we'll route to procurement on the 5th.

Regards,
Marta

Attachment: internal-intake-form.pdf (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@brightedge.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period question

Hi Marta —

Great — we'll proceed with Drive. Deliverables we'll upload to the shared folder you grant access to:

1) redacted_SOC2_TypeII_20260101-20260630.pdf (auditor redactions on client-specific attachments)
2) bridge_letter_brightedge_template.docx (auditor-signed once accepted)
3) redwood_soc2_onepager-summary.pdf (includes 2–3 sentence retention/logging note)
4) transfer_manifest.txt (file list + SHA256 checksums)

Sample retention/logging note to include in the summary (we'll include verbatim):
"Customer telemetry and audit logs are retained in encrypted storage within our US region for a default period of 90 days. Access to logs is restricted to our SRE and Security teams via role-based access controls and audited on a weekly basis"

Bridge letter template (short):

[Date]
To whom it may concern,

This letter is to confirm that Redwood Inference's internal control environment remained materially consistent from 2026-07-01 through 2026-11-30. The controls described in the attached SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-06-30) continued to operate effectively without exception.

Sincerely,
[Auditor name]
[Auditing Firm]

If that wording looks good to you we'll have our auditor prepare the signed bridge and I'll upload both files by EOD May 4.

Cheers,
Soojin
